text.p: Borussia Dortmund of Germany beat Auxerre of France 3-1 (halftime 1-0) in the first leg of their European Cup quarter-final match on Wednesday.
Borussia Dortmund - Karlheinz Riedle 12, Rene Schneider 54, Andreas Moeller 82

Dortmund - 1-Stefan Klos; 20-Wolfgang Feiersinger (3-Rene Schneider 38), 16-Martin Kree, 17-Joerg Heinrich; 7-Stefan Reuter, 14-Paul Lambert, 10-Andreas Moeller, 19-Paulo Sousa, 18-Lars Ricken (23-Rene Tretschock 90); 13-Karlheinz Riedle, 9-Stephane Chapuisat (28-Ibrahim Tanko 80).

Auxerre - 1-Lionel Charbonnier; 2-Alain Goma, 4-Franck Silvestre, 13-Frederic Danjou, 12-Taribo West; 14-Christian Henna (10-Antoine Sibierski 46), 6-Philippe Violeau, 7-Sarbri Lamouchi, 8-Moussa Saib; 9-Lilian Laslandes, 11-Bernard Diomede.
